title: Marci 6 Elves / 4 Monk

sources.label: HOW TO PLAY ★★★ Marci 6/9 Elves RAMPAGE Build In Auto Chess

body:
# Marci 6 Elves / 4 Monk

A three-star Marci is one of the most consistent carries in the meta: her Monk
passive gives her a chance on hit to instantly delete low-health targets, and
once she starts ramping she racks up rampage after rampage. The frame around her
is 6 Elves for stacking evasion and 4 Monks for the execute triggers, glued
together by 2 Wizards so you hit the elf bonus a tier early. It is a level-8
board that plays reactively — you commit to Marci by round 9-ish and then bend
the build to counter whatever the lobby throws at you.

## Why the Wizard trick works

The Elf bonus needs 6 different elves, but the Wizard class perk *Something from
Nothing* reduces the required piece count for any race/class skill by 1 (when
4+ are needed). So **5 elves + 2 Wizards = the 6-Elf, 40% evasion bonus**. Dark
Willow is the linchpin: she is both an Elf and a Wizard, so she pays into both
sides at once. Rubick is your second Wizard.

## Core Units

| Unit | Cost | Tags |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Marci | 3 | Elf, Monk (the carry) |
| Treant Protector | 3 | Druid, Elf (front-line summons) |
| Furion | 2 | Druid, Elf (Treant summons) |
| Anti-Mage | 4 | Demon Hunter, Elf (mana burn) |
| Dark Willow | 1 | Elf, Wizard |
| Rubick | 3 | God, Wizard |
| Brewmaster | 1 | Monk, Pandaren |
| Monkey King | 4 | Beast, Monk |

That gives 5 elves (Marci, Treant, Furion, Anti-Mage, Dark Willow) + 2 Wizards
= 6 Elf, plus 3 Monks (Marci, Brewmaster, Monkey King). Add a fourth Monk
(Void Spirit or Largo) at level 9 for the 4-Monk half-health-on-hit tier. Anti-
Mage's mana burn is a hidden MVP — position it to sap the enemy's key caster.

## Items

Marci's build makes or breaks the comp — most Marci games fail on items, not
units:

- **Blink Dagger** — the single most important item. It lets Marci reach the
  enemy backline instead of crawling into stuns. Without it she is far weaker.
- **Tranquil Boots** — mobility (which is also damage for her).
- **Manta Style** — illusions each proc the Monk passive, effectively fielding
  three Marcis that halve enemy HP on their own.
- **Butterfly** — evasion + attack speed to spin up her ultimate faster.
- Also great: **Radiance**, **Satanic** / any lifesteal for a last stand, and
  **Maelstrom** for extra instances of damage (each can trigger the Monk execute).

## Leveling / Roll Plan

Open on a lose streak — keep two Priests for healing while you bank. A small but
real optimization: sell an over-full bench on round 5 for max value, and grab
one extra gold on round 3 so your interest breakpoints line up. Roll for Marci
at level 7, dismissing the demons (cheap) to raise your three-star odds. Level 8 is
where the build comes online with 6 Elves + 4 Monks. If you haven't three-starred
Marci by round 31, the build falls off — that is the power curve to beat.

## Positioning / Matchup Notes

Line the elves diagonally, curving downward: Treant front, then Anti-Mage,
Panda, Monkey King, with Nature's Prophet deeper (high HP + evasion lets him
keep summoning). Keep Marci out of the front line so she isn't disabled on
engage; blink her onto the enemy backline. Dark Willow sits in the far corner as
evasion bait. The comp is stable into almost everything and hard-counters
physical boards, but is weak to burst mages and to a Gyrocopter/Divine Rapier
one-shot. Flex options: **9 Elves** (add Templar Assassin + Invoker) for the
concealment/mirror-attack tier vs physical boards, or **4 Force Staff /
Stampede** (Enchantress, Centaur, Magnus) vs mages.
